chapter: Boots and His Buddies and Wild Cherry
title: Dating the Boots band and the 1933 record sides
summary: The band formed in late 1932 and the records, including Wild Cherry, were cut in 1933 in three sides.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: What year did you join Boots' band when you cut those records? Was that somewhere in the 30s?
Yeah. In 1932 we got that band together, the last part of the 32.
Now that's the year that I was in Buffalo, New York. Yeah. Now you cut those records here in San Antonio?

No, we didn't cut the records till 33. I got to organize the band in 32. And we cut the band in 33, cut the records rather in 33, cut that Waddell Sharers. We made three sides, I think we made three sides and they put something else on the other side. And out of the two records we got three sides. And Wild Cherry was one of them.
Okay. Well that's the record, I mean that is the part.
